rules.suggestion: Use public-alpha candidate, beta candidate, self-hosted core, or production path still being hardened.

rules.description: Avoid implying hosted-service maturity before the hosted path is proven.
rules.suggestion: Use self-hostable core, hosted service later, or hosted-service work deferred.

rules.description: Avoid implying enterprise identity is complete.
rules.suggestion: Use local users, OIDC configuration foundation, or SCIM and advanced identity hardening deferred.
Use disabled-by-default action governance or managed orchestration future phase.
Use governed instruction and context registry or permission-aware retrieval for agent assets.
Use telemetry and audit foundations, recent-window admin summary, or advanced analytics deferred.

rules.description: Avoid implying API contract stability before beta freeze gates exist.
rules.suggestion: Use beta contract freeze pending, current contract target, or routes may change before beta.

rules.description: Qualify control-plane claims with agent, instruction, or context scope.
rules.suggestion: Use instruction control plane, agent context control plane, or governed instruction and context registry.
